notes.title: SPRING UPDATE: Level and Stats
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35603087/65d5189ff3bed9f70e59b17808d61ca4ad26e86c.png[/img]

Hi,

It's time for a new update to TILTit. This time around I'm happy to introduce Steam statistics accompanied with a level system that award you with experience points and ranks depending on how well you are doing in game.

On top of this, I've added a few more collectible achievements and a few smaller bug fixes.

The main menu has also been slightly reworked with explanatory text accompanying the different game modes.

I hope you all will enjoy the additions and changes.

All the best,
Mathias Berglund

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35603087/58163a52f1f661a85859cfdb098f40fbc282d599.png[/img]

notes.title: DECEMBER UPDATE: NEW GAME MODE
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35603087/a202630471edb6839c3dcd0bb02339a2f14d9fe9.png[/img]

Hello!

I'm happy to introduce Sprint as the latest game mode for TILTit. Created for short bursts of play Sprint lets you match blocks 40 times which means you have to make the most out of each time you match to climb to the top of the leaderboard.

I belive this will make a great addition to the game as both Marathon and Time Attack modes may take up to 30 minutes or more to complete. Sprint comes with its own leaderboard for both the normal mode as well as the new game+.

The following changes and additions has also been made:

Changed: The blocks now fall slightly faster due to an initial increase in game speed.
Changed: The see-saw is now slightly less sensitive to compensate for the increased speed.
Added: 5 new achievements
Fixed: Some bugs

All the best
Mathias Berglund
